parsed.use_case: A text editor can report the longest stretch of distinct characters while a user types, useful for detecting unusually varied input or evaluating a password’s character diversity. Similar checks can identify the longest non-repeating segment in streaming text.
system_examples: Streaming log processors — measure the longest run of unique characters in a message for input analysis or anomaly features.
Text editors and input validators — calculate the longest distinct-character segment when reporting text statistics or checking input rules.
parsed.explanation: A sliding window tracks the current distinct-character segment and moves its start past a repeated character, yielding O(n) time and O(min(n, alphabet size)) space. A naive check of every substring takes O(n²) or worse; the linear scan matters for long strings and streams, though this is mainly a standard string-processing exercise rather than a named production feature.
